states: Embedded production builds (vite build into internal/api/frontend-modern/dist, go build) of the parent tree (333e51d2de; rebased onto 421d1e5423, which changes only contract docs) and this tree, each on a private DEMO_MODE mock stack with a fresh data dir; the same Playwright script ran against both and produced identical results on all 31 observed fields at both widths.

Patrol on/off save whose PUT /api/settings/ai/update response (page.route) reports patrol_readiness not_ready: switching off and back on each raise only the warning toast 'Patrol setting was saved, but Patrol is not ready to run.' (role=alert inside the Notifications region, close button only); no role=alert outside the toast region, no 'needs attention' text, no readiness summary rendered inline, no Assistant action.

Failed Patrol mode save (Pro mode selector unlocked by adding ai_autofix to runtime-capabilities via page.route; PUT /api/ai/patrol/autonomy answered 500 {error}): only the error toast with the server reason; mode badge returns to Watch only; no inline error or 'needs attention' state.
Successful Patrol mode save (PUT 200, reconcile GET returns approval): Ask first becomes pressed and the badge reads Ask first; no new toast and no inline alert.

Settings > Pulse Intelligence > Patrol save (Schedule -> Every hour) and Settings > Provider & Models save with a not_ready response: only the warning toast '<saved label>, but Patrol is not ready: The selected model cannot run Patrol tools. · Provider: OpenRouter · Model: openrouter:deepseek/deepseek-r1'; no inline alert.

Patrol status with readiness not_ready (page.route on /api/ai/patrol/status): the page's own 'Patrol model issue' banner names summary, provider and model, and the header shows Fix setup, at both widths.

Dist proof: 187 files each side; after normalising chunk hashes and SRI strings only assets/AIIntelligence.js differs (935 bytes smaller): the removed failure builder, details helper and surface callback replaced by one status check, toast string byte-identical; check-bundle-size.mjs passes.
interactions: Demo sign-in; on /patrol click Toggle Patrol twice (off, then on) with a not-ready settings response; open 'Mode and automation' and click Ask first with a rejected save, then again with an accepted save; desktop mouse and phone touch (isMobile) contexts.
On /settings/pulse-intelligence/patrol select Schedule 'Every hour' and click Save Patrol settings; on /settings/pulse-intelligence click Save provider settings; both with a not-ready response.
Screenshots of each toast state captured and inspected at both widths.
